text:
Which two physical quantities must be used to calculate the power developed by a student
running up a flight of steps?
A
force exerted and the vertical height of the steps only
B
force exerted and the time taken only
C
work done and the vertical height of the steps only
D
work done and the time taken only

options.label: A
options.text: force exerted and the vertical height of the steps only

options.label: B
options.text: force exerted and the time taken only

options.label: C
options.text: work done and the vertical height of the steps only

options.label: D
options.text: work done and the time taken only
